region.description: The Flinn-Engdahl region it happened in, as EMSC names it, such as 'SICILY, ITALY' or 'NEAR EAST COAST OF HONSHU, JAPAN'.

time.description: When it happened, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, such as '2023-02-06T01:17:36.100Z'.

title.description: Magnitude and region in a few words, such as 'M7.8 CENTRAL TURKEY'.

updated.description: When its felt reports were last counted, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, such as '2023-02-06T01:17:36.100Z'.

url.description: Its page on emsc-csem.org, with maps, felt reports and nearby towns.

more_available.description: Whether more earthquakes match than were returned. Raise 'How many' or set 'Start at result' to 'next_start_at' to read them.

next_start_at.description: The 'Start at result' that reads the next page, when there is one.

total.description: How many earthquakes match in all.

search_moment_tensors.description: Find moment tensors (how faults moved) by the earthquake's time, magnitude, depth, a circle around a point and the agency that computed them, each with its earthquake and faulting style. No API key required.
search_moment_tensors.name: search_moment_tensors

parameters.description: Only earthquakes at or after this date and time (UTC).
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description: Only earthquakes at or before this date and time (UTC).
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description: Only earthquakes of at least this magnitude, such as 4.5. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: min_magnitude

parameters.description: Only earthquakes of at most this magnitude. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: max_magnitude

parameters.name: min_depth

parameters.name: max_depth

parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: The longitude of the circle's centre, such as 14.27 (east is positive).
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: How far from the circle's centre to look, in km.
parameters.name: radius_km

parameters.name: agency

parameters.description: Return only the moment tensor EMSC prefers for each earthquake. On by default.
parameters.name: preferred_only

parameters.description: The order of the results. Newest first by default.
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: start_at

count.description: How many moment tensors were returned.

moment_tensors.description: The moment tensors found, each with its earthquake.

agency.description: The agency that computed it, such as 'GCMT', 'GFZ' or 'INGV'.

centroid_time.description: The centroid time, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, such as '2023-02-06T01:17:36.100Z'.

clvd_percent.description: How much is a compensated linear vector dipole, in percent.

dip_1.description: The first nodal plane's dip, in degrees from horizontal.

dip_2.description: The second nodal plane's dip, in degrees.

double_couple_percent.description: How much of it is a plain shear on a fault (double couple), in percent.

event_id.description: The earthquake's SeismicPortal ID, such as '20230206_0000008'. Every action that takes an earthquake accepts it.

event_magnitude.description: The earthquake's magnitude as EMSC publishes it.

event_magnitude_type.description: The kind of magnitude: 'mw' (moment), 'mb' (body wave), 'ml' (local), 'md' (duration), 'ms' (surface wave), or 'm' when the agency didn't say.

event_time.description: When the earthquake happened, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, such as '2023-02-06T01:17:36.100Z'.

event_title.description: Magnitude and region in a few words, such as 'M7.8 CENTRAL TURKEY'.

event_url.description: The earthquake's page on the SeismicPortal.

faulting_style.description: How the fault moved, from its rake: 'strike-slip', 'normal', 'reverse (thrust)', 'oblique normal' or 'oblique reverse'.

p_axis_azimuth.description: The pressure (P) axis's azimuth, in degrees.

p_axis_plunge.description: The pressure (P) axis's plunge, in degrees.

preferred.description: Whether this is the moment tensor EMSC prefers.

rake_1.description: The first nodal plane's rake (slip direction), in degrees.

rake_2.description: The second nodal plane's rake, in degrees.

region.description: The Flinn-Engdahl region it happened in, as EMSC names it, such as 'SICILY, ITALY' or 'NEAR EAST COAST OF HONSHU, JAPAN'.

scalar_moment_nm.description: The seismic moment released, in newton metres.

strike_1.description: The first nodal plane's strike, in degrees from north.

strike_2.description: The second nodal plane's strike, in degrees.

t_axis_azimuth.description: The tension (T) axis's azimuth, in degrees.

t_axis_plunge.description: The tension (T) axis's plunge, in degrees.

more_available.description: Whether more match than were returned. Set 'Start at result' to 'next_start_at' to read them.

next_start_at.description: The 'Start at result' that reads the next page, when there is one.

total.description: How many moment tensors match in all.

description: Follow earthquakes worldwide as the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) reports them: search its catalogue by time, magnitude, depth and area, get the latest quakes or those near a place, count them, and look one up with every agency's solution. See what people who felt a quake reported, how its fault moved, its IDs at USGS and other agencies, and the seismic region of any point. A trigger starts a workflow for each new earthquake. No account or API key required.

emsc_seismic_portal_new_earthquake_trigg.description: Runs when EMSC publishes a new earthquake anywhere in the world, or only those from a magnitude up, in a region or near a place, once per earthquake, with its time, magnitude, depth, region and link

parameters.name: region

parameters.name: latitude

parameters.name: longitude
